configurations.comment: Same app with the database blanked, so it falls back to localStorage and accounts switch off. Lets UI work be exercised with seeded data without signing in as the owner or touching the real log. Set EMPTY rather than unset: Next loads .env.local itself and would refill an unset var, but it never overrides one already present in the environment. hasDb() reads exactly these two.
